name: Root Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Root Ventures (root.vc), the San Francisco deep-tech seed fund founded by Avidan Ross; site address 2670 Harrison St, San Francisco, matching the Form Ds for Root Ventures III and IV, L.P. All four EDGAR entities (Root Ventures I-IV, L.P.) are signed by Avidan Ross as manager of the GP. Fund I was first filed in Dec 2014 as 'Lion Wells Ventures I, L.P.' (same CIK 1627221, LA address) and renamed Root Ventures I by its 2015 amendment. Not Root, Inc. (car insurer), not Root Capital (agricultural impact lender), not Roots Ventures or other similarly named funds.

open_items: Company LinkedIn page: root.vc links only Twitter, GitHub and Instagram (schema.org sameAs); no LinkedIn company URL was found on a firm page, so none was recorded.

application_url: no pitch form on root.vc; the site's terminal has an 'email' command ('reach out to us') pointing to the firm's general inbox, and the Fund III post points founders to root.vc for contact details. Not recorded as a URL.
portfolio_count_reported: no firm-stated total found. root.vc lists 70 companies; CB Insights shows '104 Investments'; TechCrunch (2018) says the debut fund took stakes in 27 companies.

Indian founders: nothing stated. requires_us_entity: nothing stated; the portfolio includes non-US companies (Fund III's first three spanned South Africa; Latent Technology is London-based; Loombotic is Toronto-based per its YC page), but legal structure requirements are not published.

Fund close dates: Fund I uses the Form D/A filing date reporting the offering fully sold (first sale 2014-12-18); Funds II and III use the firm's announcement dates; Fund IV uses the month of the Newcomer exclusive (paywalled beyond the opening). EDGAR shows only the initial 2025-01-10 Form D for Fund IV, with no amendment reporting sales.
Root's Medium post URLs return 403; the Fund II and Fund III posts were read in full through the publication's RSS feed (medium.com/feed/root-ventures).

Rounds in the last 24 months are thin: only Illoca, DeepWeave, Latent Technology and Volund Manufacturing were found naming Root. The web-search budget ran out mid-research, so recent additions to the root.vc portfolio (Loombotic, Ground Control Dev, PhyAgents, Lithos Computer, Vibe Robotics, Feather, Digichem, Loopwork, Gen Alpha, Subtrace) have no round page recorded; their sites show Root only as an investor logo or not at all.

Volund Manufacturing seed ($12M, 2026-06-04) is from CB Insights only (database, low confidence); volundmfg.com has no funding information and Root's site does not yet list Volund. Root's role in the round is not stated.

Skipped because the round page does not name Root: Quilter $25M Series B (Oct 2025, led by Index Ventures), Zed $32M Series B (Aug 2025, Sequoia 'with participation from our existing investors'; Zed's about page shows a Root logo), Dusty Robotics $45M Series B (May 2022). AllSpice's $15M round (June 2025) appears in an AlleyWatch report that lists Root among all-time backers, not in that round.
ApertureData's $3M seed was announced 2022-02-08 but, per TechCrunch, closed in October 2021.

Emily Henriksson (ex-Tesla/SpaceX, hardtech and climate) was a partner per the Aug 2022 Fund III post but is not on the current root.vc team list; not recorded. Partner focus sectors are drawn from site bios and the 2018/2022 Medium posts (Kane: 'industrial automation guru'; Lee: 'to focus on devtools').
HQ country, website and founding year are missing for several round companies where the round page did not state them.
